svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Infra view (⌥4), on-prem data centre lon-dc1 hall B, physical layout in 3D
svg.desc: Infra view of the on-prem data centre lon-dc1, hall B, in the physical-layout variant, seen in perspective at ladder level L2 Hall with row B2 in focus. The raised floor carries three rows of eight rack cabinets, B1 to B3, labelled on the floor (B1-01 to B3-08). Hosts are U-slot blocks on each cabinet front, near-monochrome grey when healthy; the near row B1 is drawn as x-ray outlines so row B2 stays visible. Hypervisor host esx-b2-07 (64 cores, 1 TiB) is pulled out above rack B2-07 as a cut-away stack of VM slabs whose thickness is vCPU and whose fill is usage: vm-pg-legacy, vm-erp-app-1, vm-erp-app-2 and vm-build-03, which is Watch with CPU ready 9 %. Each rack carries a thin top-of-rack switch slab; two taller spine switches stand at the end of row B2. Links found by neighbour discovery run as overhead cable-tray arcs from every top-of-rack switch to both spines with utilisation particles; the selected link tor-b2-04 to spine-1 is Degraded with 340 CRC errors per minute. A firewall appliance pair and a load-balancer appliance stand as gates at the hall entrance, badged appliance. The storage array array-b (412 TiB, 71 % used) is a wide cabinet at the end of row B3 with dotted volume threads to the hypervisor hosts that mount its LUNs. Self-hosted pg-legacy (a postgres cylinder on vm-pg-legacy) and kafka-onprem (a ribbon) stand on the floor near their hosts with the same shapes as managed services and no managed badge. Facilities: PDU bars on each rack front show load, rack B2-04 at 92 % is Watch, and a warm thermal haze lies over row B2 at 29 °C inlet. Docked 2D panels on the right follow the selected link: interface errors per minute for tor-b2-04 eth1/49 from 12:00 to 12:35, port utilisation of the top-of-rack uplinks, and PDU load by rack. HUD: top bar with breadcrumb on-prem, lon-dc1, hall B, row B2 and the INC-2041 badge, view switcher with Infra active, layout toggle with Physical active, altitude ladder, hall header strip, T hint for the 2D rack elevation, and the Time Ribbon. Six numbered callouts explain the encodings.
